mode: read-only source comparison; no new discovery module or account requests
scope: Remaining reference methods compared with current home/rank/page/replies implementations. This is not a completion percentage.

fallback.trigger: empty cleaned primary list or any primary error

conclusions.desktop: rank(type=week) has identical primary URL; rank(type=day) exposes fallback period explicitly
conclusions.remaining: title is omitted; no automatic empty/error period change. This recovery behavior is distinct from a new native feature.

conclusions.desktop: Fixed page dispatcher accepts these descriptors, but no guaranteed dedicated 快讯 tab. Service-returned home/discovery channels may expose it.
conclusions.remaining: Not equivalent to main/indexV8, chronological comment sorting, or homeUpdates. Native visible fast-news entry and recovery need a workflow check.

conclusions.desktop: Fixed page accepts the fragment descriptor. homeEditorChoice requests /v6/feed/editorChoiceList instead.
conclusions.remaining: Editor selection and digest selection are different evidenced APIs; do not mark digest parity by endpoint overlap.

conclusions.desktop: Detail 热门评论 uses replies -> /v6/feed/replyList, listType=popular, discussMode=1, feedType=feed,blockStatus=0
conclusions.remaining: No hotReplyList operation; ordinary popular replies cannot prove identical curated hot-comment response.

conclusions.desktop: Current rank dictionary has week/day/month/picture only
conclusions.remaining: 收藏榜 favorite and 指数榜 index have exact known fields but no default native controls. Day is a desktop explicit period, not a replacement for favorite/index.

reference.extract: First five topic entities, title as tag, hot_num/commentnum/comment_num as count

conclusions.desktop: Page dispatcher can read V9 topic square with named public read evidence; no identical five-item sidebar extraction required by current UI
conclusions.remaining: Do not claim an identical native sidebar simply because topic square is accessible.

reference.other: Fixed dataList descriptor, wraps a bare board tag into /page?url=TAG

conclusions.desktop: init/page/home/homeHeadline cover known routed boards; generic page only accepts documented route families
conclusions.remaining: No automatic mapping of every arbitrary board descriptor, guest prefetch mode or cleaning behavior.

conclusions.desktop: Native app/game tabs and game keyword search exist
conclusions.remaining: No dedicated six-choice keyword category controls; recommend APK route is not the same taxonomy.

conclusions.desktop: CatalogAppRecommend and apk search are implemented; fixed page whitelist currently lacks apk/rankList and apk/newestList
conclusions.remaining: General recommendation/search does not establish original application ranking/latest/category workflows.

noChange: Reported contracts and differences only. Root owns final integration/audit; unknown protocols remain unknown.

resolution.note: Subsequent fixed-contract native read integrations; the earlier conclusions below remain the original source comparison.
